expiresAt.description:
ExpiresAt is the 90-day rotation deadline. Empty for legacy keys; the
UI treats absent values as "no expiry" so legacy keys keep working
until rotated.

scopes.description:
Scopes is the comma-separated scope string stored on the key. Empty for
legacy keys (which default to all scopes at validation).

workspaceId.description:
WorkspaceID is set for a Workspace key (data-plane, bound) and empty for
an account-wide Admin key. The dashboard derives the type badge from it.

message.description: Message is an optional commit-style note describing the change.

content.description:
Content is the raw source document (JSON, YAML, RDF, etc.). Mutually
exclusive with URL: supply one or the other.

format.description:
Format is an explicit converter id (e.g. "arrows") or "auto"/"" to
detect from the content.

url.description:
URL, when set and Content is empty, is fetched server-side (https only,
SSRF-guarded, size-capped) and its body used as the content.

message.example: the workspace database is unreachable or has been removed; reprovision it or update the external connection

message.description: Message is an optional commit-style note describing the change.

action.description:
Action is currently only "confirm" - auto-applies merges to every
pending pair whose confidence is at least MinConfidence. PRD §6
"bulk-confirm all ≥ 0.95 confidence" workflow.

category.description:
Category is "workspace" or "admin". Empty defaults to "admin" so the
legacy {label}-only body keeps minting account-wide keys.

workspaceId.description:
WorkspaceID is required for a workspace key and forbidden for an admin
key. Scopes are NOT accepted from the client: they are derived from the
category to keep the data/control-plane boundary unforgeable.

properties.description:
Properties carries typed property values for the entity. On an explicit
API write the ontology's `required` properties are enforced here (hard
422); the extraction path flags-not-drops instead (E2/Q13 asymmetry).

type.description:
binding tags are for OpenAPI required-field generation; runtime validation
is enforced manually below because decoding is done with json.Decoder.

theme.description: App runtime (from React hooks at submit time)

procedureFormat.description: Optional per-run override for the graph-vs-prose eval A/B: "graph"|"prose".

client_id.description:
ClientID binds the rotation to the originating client (RFC 9700 §4.14).
Required when the stored token has a ClientID; optional otherwise so
first-party (non-OAuth) refresh callers continue to work.

action.description: Action must be one of confirm | reject | merge_into.

mergeInto.description:
MergeIntoTarget overrides the merge target when Action == merge_into.
Defaults to TargetID. Useful when the reviewer prefers a third entity
over the resolver's pick.

sourceId.description:
SourceID + TargetID are required because pairId is a one-way hash -
we need the underlying IDs to MATCH the SAME_AS edge.

focusEntityIds.description: narrows a re-distill to one community (F1/F2)

pii_sensitive.description:
PIISensitive marks a type whose entities are subject to redaction
policies. Surfaced to the extraction worker; consumed by retrieval.

batch_size.description: BatchSize caps the per-transaction node count. 0 → default (1000).

dedup_by_name.description:
DedupByName runs a tiered duplicate-entity pass after the type mappings:
same-name + same-(canonical)-type entities are auto-merged; same-name +
different-type collisions are routed to HITL as pending SAME_AS pairs.
Typically paired with property-keyed type-canonicalization mappings so the
casing-split duplicates collapse once their types agree.

domain.description:
Domain is the create-context-graph metadata block (may be empty for
the _base template itself).

entity_types.description: EntityTypes is the fully merged list (base + domain).

extraction_aliases.description:
ExtractionAliases maps an extraction SURFACE form to a declared
entity-type label (surface → type, N:1) — e.g. "doctor" → "Provider",
"physician" → "Provider". The deterministic alias pass and GLiNER label
derivation consume this direction. Legacy type → surface rows are flipped
on read by NormalizeExtractionAliases. See extraction_aliases.go.

relationships.description: Relationships is the fully merged list.

message.description:
Message is an optional commit-style note explaining what changed in
this revision. Surfaced in the Version History UI + diff header.

pii.description:
PII marks this property's values as personally-identifiable. Values are
transformed per the workspace's PII action (hash/redact/store-as-is) at
every choke point they flow through — property-write, embedding, and
observation/reflection (Q9). The default hash is deterministic so a
hashed Unique property still dedups via the unique-key resolver.

match_by.description:
MatchBy selects how nodes are matched for this mapping:
  "label" (default) — MATCH (n:<From>); for renaming an existing type LABEL.
  "property"        — MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.type = <From>; for backfilling
                      legacy entities that carry only the :Entity label and a
                      `type` property (no type label), e.g. canonicalizing
                      "tool" → "SoftwareTool".

to_pole.description:
ToPole is the canonical POLE base label (e.g. "Object") to also stamp on the
node in property mode, materializing the (:Entity:<Pole>:<To>) label scheme.
Optional; ignored in label mode.

info.description: API key (nams_...) used directly as Bearer token, or JWT from Auth0 exchange
info.title: NAMS Memory API

get.description:
**Auth service base URL:** `https://memory.neo4jlabs.com`

Returns the public RSA key(s) used to verify NAMS JWTs. Used by other services for token validation.

**Auth service base URL:** `https://memory.neo4jlabs.com`

List API keys owned by the authenticated user. Raw key values are never returned - only metadata (ID, label, created/revoked/expiry timestamps). Auth: requires a user token or an Admin API key (workspace:admin); workspace-bound data keys are rejected with 403.

200.description: Returns keys array with id, label, createdAt, revokedAt, expiresAt

403.description: Requires a user token or an Admin API key

post.description:
**Auth service base URL:** `https://memory.neo4jlabs.com`

Generate a new API key owned by the authenticated user. The category selects the key's privilege and binding: "workspace" requires a workspaceId and produces a data-plane key bound to that workspace (scopes derived server-side, never workspace:admin); "admin" forbids workspaceId and produces an account-wide key with full scopes. Category defaults to "admin" when omitted. The raw key is returned once and also stored encrypted-at-rest for later reveal; it is bcrypt-validated on every request. Auth: requires a user token or an Admin API key (workspace:admin); workspace-bound data keys are rejected with 403.

201.description: Key ID, raw key (save this), and label

403.description: Requires a user token or an Admin API key

delete.description:
**Auth service base URL:** `https://memory.neo4jlabs.com`

Revoke an API key by ID. The key is immediately invalidated - any active JWTs issued from it are blocklisted. This action is irreversible. Owner-only: only the user who owns the key can revoke it. Non-owners receive 404 (indistinguishable from a missing key) to prevent key-id enumeration. Auth: requires a user token or an Admin API key (workspace:admin); workspace-bound data keys are rejected with 403.

403.description: Requires a user token or an Admin API key

404.description: Key not found or not owned by caller

get.description:
**Auth service base URL:** `https://memory.neo4jlabs.com`

Returns the decrypted raw API key value for keys created with encrypted storage. Owner-only: only the user who owns the key can reveal it. Non-owners receive 404 (indistinguishable from a missing key) to prevent credential disclosure and key-id enumeration. Returns 410 if the key was revoked or predates encrypted storage. Auth: requires a user token or an Admin API key (workspace:admin); workspace-bound data keys are rejected with 403.

200.description: Key ID and decrypted raw key

403.description: Requires a user token or an Admin API key

404.description: Key not found or not owned by caller

post.description:
**Auth service base URL:** `https://memory.neo4jlabs.com`

Mint a new API key inheriting the old key's label and scopes, and atomically revoke the old one. The new raw key is returned exactly once in the response (and is also persisted encrypted-at-rest so it can be revealed again later). Owner-only: only the user who owns the key can rotate it. Non-owners receive 404 (indistinguishable from a missing key) to prevent key-id enumeration. Auth: requires a user token or an Admin API key (workspace:admin); workspace-bound data keys are rejected with 403.

200.description: New key ID, new raw key (save this), and inherited label

403.description: Requires a user token or an Admin API key

404.description: Key not found or not owned by caller

post.description:
**Auth service base URL:** `https://memory.neo4jlabs.com`

Validate an Auth0 Bearer token via JWKS and return per-workspace NAMS JWTs. Automatically provisions a default workspace for first-time users. Returns an array of {workspace_id, token} pairs - one per workspace the user belongs to.

200.description: Returns workspaces array with workspace_id and token

post.summary: Exchange Auth0 token for NAMS JWTs

post.description:
**Auth service base URL:** `https://memory.neo4jlabs.com`

Handles OAuth2 authorization code flow. Exchanges the provider code for user info and returns a NAMS JWT. Currently returns 501 - implementation pending.

**Auth service base URL:** `https://memory.neo4jlabs.com`

Exchange a refresh token for a new access token and rotated refresh token.

The title is read from the conversation's metadata "title" key (set metadata.title at creation to give a conversation a display name); firstMessageSnippet is the first message's content truncated to 120 characters. Both are empty strings when unset.

Record a tool invocation made by an agent during a reasoning step. Optionally link to a step via stepId.

`input` and `output` must be JSON-encoded strings, not objects. Pre-serialize structured payloads before sending (e.g. `"input": "{\"query\":\"foo\"}"`, not `"input": {"query":"foo"}`). The graph stores them as scalar string properties on the :ToolCall node.

Status values: `pending`, `success` (default), `failure`, `error`, `timeout`, `cancelled`. Legacy `completed`/`failed` are accepted and rewritten to `success`/`failure`.
